title.narrative: Strengthening citizen participation in local governance and social cohesion through CLGPs in Baraka

description.narrative: The project aims to enable and promote the participation of men, women and youth in local democratic governance and their involvement in environmental preservation in the town of Baraka, South Kivu Province. The project intends to support citizen actions through capacity building of local participatory governance committees (CLGP) in environmental governance, in advocacy techniques and in citizen control of municipal authorities' actions. The members of the CLGP of Baraka will be involved in mobilizing other community members to promote behaviour change for the improvement of local governance and a better management of the environment and their living environment. In the same perspective, through permanent joint dialogue frameworks with the government, they will hold local authorities and decision makers accountable for adopting and implementing policies and strategies to improve the local governance system. The project will ensure more inclusive norms and practices towards women and youth by formal and informal key power holders will contribute to an enabling environment for women and youth participation in decision-making. The project will be implemented by CDJP Uvira staff with support from CAFOD Governance and Peace building Program
